title: John Bolton
description: Explains John Bolton: "I was always very impressed with Boba Fett. He isn't on screen all that much, and he has just a few lines of dialogue. Yet he resonates..." Bolton began working in comics in the late '70s and made his initial impact on the U.S. market in 1980. An award-winning illustrator from England, he's worked on graphic novels and prestige format comic books with Chris Claremont, Neil Gaiman, Clive Barker and Anne Rice, among many others. Currently, Bolton is rendering MANBAT for DC . His interest in the stylishly bizarre can be seen throughout his work and in the extraordinary objects surrounding his drawing board...many of which are dead or asleep.
